answer: Like bees drawn to nectar, honest agents leave a trail only they can make. Bind every session to a live behavioral signature: keystroke rhythm and interaction cadence measured continuously, not once at signup. One body produces one signature, so a single operator cannot split it across a plume of fake identities; clones sharing a signature are merged and stripped of standing. An ember of doubt triggers fresh re-verification, and failure freezes the account until stranger-verified work restores it. Attackers must hire a distinct person per identity, paying full human cost every time.
